signs.aries: You earn in bursts and spend on impulse, and the money that arrives tends to come from something you started yourself.
signs.taurus: You build wealth slowly and keep it, take real pleasure in owning good things, and are very reluctant to part with any of them.
signs.gemini: You have several income streams rather than one, your finances fluctuate with your attention, and you talk about money easily.
signs.cancer: Security feels emotional rather than numerical for you, and what you own is tangled up with family, home and memory.
signs.leo: You spend generously and visibly, would rather have one good thing than five adequate ones, and your worth is tied to being appreciated.
signs.virgo: You track every figure, are quietly anxious about having enough regardless of what you have, and earn through being useful.
signs.libra: Your money is entangled with other people's, you spend on beauty and on company, and you find financial confrontation genuinely hard.
signs.scorpio: You are private about what you have, treat money as leverage rather than comfort, and go through periods of complete financial reinvention.
signs.sagittarius: You are casual with money and it mostly works out, you spend on travel and learning, and you dislike being tied to possessions.
signs.capricorn: You take earning seriously from young, are cautious with what you have, and end up more secure than people who worried less.
signs.aquarius: You hold unorthodox views on money and ownership, your income comes from unusual directions, and you resent being valued by your salary.
signs.pisces: Money slips through your hands without much accounting, you give it away readily, and you would rather not think about it at all.
